game: BUF @ LA, Week 5 2026 (kickoff time, spread, total not in pack)

script.base: Spread/total unsaved, so this is form-only. LA should move it through Davante Adams (weeks 2-4: 32 targets, 364 yards, 563 air yards) into a BUF pass defense that has allowed 8.13 YPA middle, 8.37 YPA right and 17 passes of 20+ in four games, with Kyren Williams (43 carries, 253 rush yards, 5.9 YPC over those three weeks) getting chunk runs against BUF's 4.12 YPC and 14 runs of 10+. BUF answers with James Cook (57/364, 6.4 YPC) and Josh Allen, who does not drop off vs the blitz (EPA/db 0.28 blitz vs 0.29 clean; both teams blitz 33%), but LA's defense caps that (3.96 rush YPC, only 8 runs of 10+, pass YPA 4.64-5.00, only 5 passes of 20+). Base: competitive to LA-leaning, both LA phases live, no numbered blowout.
script.flip1: BUF leads early on a Cook or Allen explosive that LA has rarely allowed. LA trails, Stafford (EPA/db -0.33 vs blitz, +0.19 clean) is forced to throw into BUF's 33% blitz, Kyren's carries fall, Adams' targets rise, and Cook keeps or gains clock carries if Buffalo is protecting a lead.
script.flip2: LA leads big and runs the clock. Adams' late targets stall, Kyren's carries rise, and BUF abandons the run so Cook's rushing line dies while Shakir/Coleman/Kincaid chase garbage yards into a LA secondary with almost no explosives. A weather slog is a possible second drag on the pass, but the forecast is not saved.

injury_fallout: Known from the pre-game nflverse report in the pack; final inactives (~90 min pre-kick) are not in the pack. BUF DE Ed Oliver Out (knee) and DE Landon Jackson Questionable (knee) thin the front that produced BUF's four-game defensive totals, so Stafford has a better chance to hold the ball for Adams and Williams faces a softer run fit than 4.12 YPC. BUF WR Josh Palmer Out (shoulder): next men are Khalil Shakir (17 targets, team-high in weeks 2-4), Keon Coleman (15 targets, 216 yards, 201 air) and Dalton Kincaid (13 targets, 140 yards). DJ Moore is only Questionable (shoulder), so his targets are not assumed vacated. BUF CB Dee Alford Questionable (ankle): if he sits, the secondary that already bleeds middle/right is thinner for Adams. LA S Quentin Lake Questionable (hip): if he sits, Coleman' s deep shots get a safety bump, but LA has still allowed only 5 passes of 20+. No OL out on either side.
